components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The leading action: tactile, compact, and unmistakably wayfinding.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.625rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--bs-primary); border-radius: 0.25rem; background: var(--bs-primary); color: var(--bs-white); font: 650 0.875rem/1.25 system-ui, sans-serif; transition: filter 150ms ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(0.92); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: var(--bs-focus-ring-width) solid var(--bs-focus-ring-color); outline-offset: 0.125rem; } .ds-btn-primary:active { filter: brightness(0.84); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A quiet supporting action that stays subordinate to the primary route.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.625rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--bs-primary); border-radius: 0.25rem; background: transparent; color: var(--bs-primary); font: 650 0.875rem/1.25 system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease-in-out, color 150ms ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--bs-primary-bg-subtle); color: var(--bs-primary-text-emphasis); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: var(--bs-focus-ring-width) solid var(--bs-focus-ring-color); outline-offset: 0.125rem; } .ds-btn-outline:active { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bs-primary) 14%, var(--bs-light)); }

components.name: Account Form Field
components.description: A labeled Paper White field with quiet help text and a confident teal focus state.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.25rem; color: var(--bs-body-color); font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field > span { font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: 0.01em; } .ds-field input { min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.625rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color); border-radius: 0.25rem; background: var(--bs-white); color: var(--bs-body-color); font: 400 1rem/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: var(--bs-primary); box-shadow: 0 0 0 var(--bs-focus-ring-width) var(--bs-focus-ring-color); outline: 0; } .ds-field small { color: var(--bs-secondary-color); font-size: 0.75rem; }

components.name: Active Wayfinding Route
components.description: A full-label navigation row with a uniform leading lane and teal active rail.
components.html: Dashboard
components.css: .ds-route-active { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.625rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 0.25rem; background: var(--bs-primary-bg-subtle); color: var(--bs-primary-text-emphasis); font: 650 0.875rem/1.25 system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-route-active::before { position: absolute; top: 0.375rem; bottom: 0.375rem; left: 0; width: 0.25rem; border-radius: 0 0.25rem 0.25rem 0; background: var(--bs-primary); content: ""; } .ds-route-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 2rem; height: 2rem; } .ds-route-icon svg { width: 1.25rem; fill: currentColor; } .ds-route-active:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bs-primary) 10%, var(--bs-light)); } .ds-route-active:focus-visible { outline: var(--bs-focus-ring-width) solid var(--bs-focus-ring-color); outline-offset: 0.125rem; }

components.name: Flat Working Board
components.description: A bounded operational field that groups one coherent task without ambient elevation.
components.html:
Evaluate roster

Filter the player field, then open a participant to record observations.
components.css: .ds-board { padding: 1.5rem; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color); border-radius: 0.375rem; background: var(--bs-white); color: var(--bs-body-color); font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-board h3 { margin: 0 0 0.375rem; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: 0.01em; } .ds-board p { max-width: 65ch; margin: 0; color: var(--bs-secondary-color); line-height: 1.7; }

components.name: Account Directory Panel
components.description: A tactile sign panel whose punched edge marks the current account area.
components.css: .ds-account-panel { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.625rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--bs-primary-border-subtle); border-radius: 0.25rem; background: var(--bs-primary-bg-subtle); color: var(--bs-primary-text-emphasis); font: 650 0.875rem/1.25 system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-account-panel::before { position: absolute; top: 0.375rem; bottom: 0.375rem; left: -1px; width: 0.25rem; border-radius: 0.25rem 0 0 0.25rem; background: var(--bs-primary); content: ""; } .ds-account-panel:hover { border-color: var(--bs-primary); } .ds-account-panel:focus-visible { outline: var(--bs-focus-ring-width) solid var(--bs-focus-ring-color); outline-offset: 0.125rem; }

components.name: Success Status Strip
components.description: A bounded matte band that communicates state with both language and semantic color.
components.css: .ds-status-success { min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--bs-success-border-subtle); border-radius: 0.25rem; background: var(--bs-success-bg-subtle); color: var(--bs-success-text-emphasis); font: 650 0.875rem/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Campaign Route Markers
components.description: Connected, labeled stops make campaign progress spatially legible without relying on color alone.
components.css: .ds-route-markers { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(5rem, 1fr)); min-width: 24rem; margin: 0; padding: 0; color: var(--bs-secondary-color); font: 650 0.75rem/1.25 system-ui, sans-serif; list-style: none; } .ds-route-markers li { position: relative; display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; } .ds-route-markers li:not(:last-child)::after { position: absolute; top: 0.4375rem; left: calc(50% + 0.625rem); width: calc(100% - 1.25rem); height: 1px; background: var(--bs-border-color); content: ""; } .ds-route-markers i { z-index: 1; width: 0.875rem; height: 0.875rem; border: 2px solid var(--bs-border-color); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--bs-white); } .ds-route-markers .is-complete i, .ds-route-markers .is-active i { border-color: var(--bs-primary); background: var(--bs-primary); } .ds-route-markers .is-active { color: var(--bs-primary-text-emphasis); } .ds-route-markers .is-active i { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.25rem var(--bs-primary-bg-subtle); }

narrative.overview:
Nova should feel like entering a well-run fieldhouse where every sign, roster sheet, and route marker helps staff make the next decision. The visual language is operational, grounded, and quietly confident: matte enamel signs provide orientation, pale field sheets hold the work, ink-dark type carries authority, and restrained state colors clarify what needs attention.

The system is tactile, legible, and restrained. It favors physical organization over software ornament: stable rails, bounded boards, precise hairlines, compact roster rows, and visible workflow stops. Marketing surfaces may expand this world into large-scale route diagrams and offset printed layers; application surfaces stay calmer and denser so club administrators and evaluators can work quickly.
keyCharacteristics: Physical wayfinding metaphors without nostalgic decoration.
Flat operational boards with precise borders and strong information hierarchy.
Large, compressed campaign language paired with quiet, readable working text.
Teal wayfinding, gold attention, and ink-dark structure used by semantic role.
Responsive navigation that preserves every route and full label.

rules.name: The Wayfinding Rule
rules.body: Wayfinding Teal belongs to primary action and orientation, never ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Gold Means Attention Rule
rules.body: Signal Amber marks unresolved work; it must not become a competing brand accent.

rules.name: The State Has Words Rule
rules.body: Color never carries status alone; pair it with a label, icon, count, or accessible state.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Build hierarchy through scale, weight, tracking, and case before introducing another typeface.

rules.name: The Working Text Rule
rules.body: Operational labels remain at least `0.875rem`; smaller type is reserved for brief metadata or non-interactive captions.

rules.name: The One Route Rule
rules.body: Navigation and workflow progress remain visible as one legible route; never hide required destinations or abbreviate labels into ambiguity.

rules.name: The Board, Not Cards Rule
rules.body: Group operational work into purposeful fields, directories, and bounded boards instead of repeating generic summary cards.

rules.name: The Flat Operations Rule
rules.body: Working boards, forms, directories, tables, and navigation rest without ambient shadows.

rules.name: The Printed Layer Exception
rules.body: Crisp offset layers belong only to marketing compositions that depict physical sheets or signs.

rules.name: The Functional Circle Rule
rules.body: Use circles only for people, status, route markers, or the brand dot—never as decoration.

rules.name: The Precise Edge Rule
rules.body: Borders are one-pixel hairlines; the active navigation rail may grow to `0.25rem` because it carries route state.

dos: Do use Wayfinding Teal for the primary action, active route, or deliberate orientation cue.
Do build operational hierarchy with flat boards, hairlines, spacing, and typography.
Do preserve complete navigation with full labels across responsive states.
Do keep controls and mobile actions at least `2.75rem` high.
Do use semantic Bootstrap variables in component styles and keep the Sass palette as the implementation token source.
Do generalize fieldhouse and workflow metaphors across club sports rather than relying on soccer-only decoration.
donts: Don't fall back to generic SaaS card grids or walls of interchangeable summary tiles.
Don't use ornamental sports motifs, stadium clichés, or soccer-specific decoration as product identity.
Don't use gradient surface fills, glass effects, or ambient shadows; hairline construction gradients are acceptable only when they render structural rules rather than depth.
Don't use decorative pills or circles; every rounded compact shape must communicate a real status, person, route stop, or control.
Don't hardcode palette hex values in component CSS; use the semantic `--bs-*` variables.
Don't let Signal Amber compete with primary action or use color as the only expression of state.
